slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The brief says the factory operates two shifts with 110 hours of weekly production time — is 110 hours the total regular (non-overtime) capacity available across both shifts, with any production beyond 110 hours counted as overtime to be minimized?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent clarified that 110 hours is regular capacity and that production beyond it is overtime, but did not ask whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal with priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any upper limit on how much overtime hours can be used per week, or is overtime unlimited (only penalized in the objective)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime upper limit exists and learned it is 10 hours, but did not ask whether the 10-hour limit is a strict constraint or a soft prioritized goal.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour regular capacity is treated as a hard capacity ceiling, and fully utilizing 110 hours is not modeled as a prioritized goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal with priority; it silently treated it as a capacity ceiling.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is treated as a hard constraint rather than a prioritized goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent confirmed the existence of a 10-hour overtime limit but never asked whether it is a strict upper bound or a soft target with priority.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slots about the nature and priority of the 110-hour utilization goal and the 10-hour overtime limit remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions and confirmed the primary objective, capacity interpretation, and lack of profit relevance, but it failed to resolve the two P0 hidden slots about whether the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit are hard constraints or prioritized soft goals, then stopped prematurely.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
